Name: Soft Pink Tools
Author: maeissimming
Description:
This is a simple tool recolor in soft pinks that are meant to add a dash of pink without being overwhelming to the cozy vibe of the game.

Base tools keep their original wood color and have soft pink metal.
Copper tools are pink toned copper metal.
Gold tools are rose gold metal.
Iron tools keep their original wood color and gold stripe and have soft pink metal.
Iridium tools are a brighter pink.
The return scepter is the same bright pink as iridium tools.
The milk pail and sheers are the same soft pink as the base and iron tools.
The copper pan is the same pink copper as the copper tools.
The training rod has soft pink and the original wood. The bamboo poll also has the original wood and pink metal. The fiberglass rod is the same coloring as the copper tools. The iridium rod is bright pink like the other iridium tools.

The scythe is not included in this mod as scythes are "weapons" in the game. I'll be recoloring the weapons soon, so keep an eye out for that!
